To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the test-taking strategies of high and low performing Chinese speaking participants when answering English multiple choice reading questions are different, and that there is a relationship between strategy use by participants and their performance on the TOEIC reading section.

the test taking strategies employed by the participants in the TOEIC Reading test can be categorized into four groups, namely word/lexical based strategies, sentence based strategies, reading comprehension strategies and overall technical approaches, and that the test taking strategy use is related to the test takers' reading performance.
the use of strategies is positively related to the performance of TOEIC Reading comprehension test takers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the test takers' use of reading comprehension and test taking strategies, the relationship between the two, and the effect on reading performance.
how Chinese speakers use strategies when they answer English reading comprehension questions, and what relationship exists between the use of strategies and their test performances.
the use of test taking strategies in answering multiple choice reading comprehension items.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the test takers who scored higher than the others were more likely to apply the following strategies: word/lexical, sentence based, and overall technical strategies.
high scoring participants are more likely to employ a wider variety of strategies than low scoring participants and that the employment of strategies is positively related to test performance.
the participants who used the strategies more often and more successfully were more successful in answering the reading comprehension questions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of reading strategies is not the only determinant of test takers' performance.
the test taking strategies employed by high and low scoring students are different.
the use of test taking strategies has an impact on students' reading performance, which is in line with the literature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
test takers' performance is not simply determined by the test itself, but is also affected by their own cognitive and metacognitive processes.
the use of reading comprehension strategies is the most significant indicator for high scoring participants.
the employment of reading strategies is a complex process that requires the integration of a variety of skills and abilities.
